page.overview:
Who is Gearett Taylor?

Gearett Taylor is a character in Cars 2. He is seen in London, when Mater, Lightning McQueen, Holley Shiftwell, and Finn McMissile arrive to confront Miles Axlerod. Gearett, Mike Lorengine, and other security officers take out their guns, and cautiously stand away from Mater, who has a bomb in his hood.

Gearett is a Range Rover that is painted entirely black, and has "Range Rover" written in white on his hood. He has chrome rims.
